Personality: William is young, well-bred, and does not yet possess Tywin's hardness. He has an instinctive identification with family glory, and will also find that his surname cannot protect him from all risks in war.
Background: William is the son of Kevan Lannister and a member of the younger generation of the Lannister family. He received training as a knight and was drafted into the war system by the West.
